noah_cs: FYI - ThunderBay sent back the risk form. Key asks: BYOK for embeddings, 30-day retention for vectors, and a breakdown of processing regions in our SOC2 excerpt. They said they'll pause renewal discussions until BYOK is confirmed.

dana_se: Ugh. Do we have a concise customer-facing statement for BYOK/retention? I can spin it into a one-line for their security team.

kai_security: Short, safe wording: `Redwood provides customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments. Our Hosted API uses provider-managed keys; we can evaluate contractual retention commitments for Hosted on a case-by-case basis.`

noah_cs: Can we also give them an example config snippet for Dedicated so they see it's supported?

ritesh_success: Example we use in pre-sales: ```yaml
deployment: dedicated
kms: customer_managed
embeddings_retention_days: 30
notes: "Retention policy enforced by contract and config; proof via audit log export"
```

noah_cs: Perfect. I'll attach that. Kai - where's the SOC2 region exhibit I can share?

kai_security: Uploaded redacted region exhibit: https://redwood.internal/security/soc2/redacted/regions-2025.pdf. Also add: full SOC2 available under NDA.

ana_legal: (typo) sorry, ana_legal: Legal note: We can offer a limited retention SLA in an addendum for Hosted, but any BYOK promise must be tied to a product engagement (Dedicated/Private) or a funded roadmap acceleration. I'll draft an addendum template if you want to propose Hosted retention as a stop-gap.

noah_cs: Good to know. Customer specifically asked for proof of deletion. Can we export a short audit sample showing an embeddings delete operation?

kai_security: We can produce a redacted audit snippet from Dedicated test cluster showing the delete event and KMS key-id. For Hosted we don't have per-customer BYOK ops to show.

ritesh_success: I'll prep a short one-pager: "How we support BYOK+retention (Dedicated)" with architecture diagram + timeline. ETA tomorrow EOD.

cs-bot: New ticket created: CS-6022 - "ThunderBay vendor form: BYOK + 30d retention" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6022)

noah_cs: Action list: 1) dana_se - send redacted SOC2 link + Kai's BYOK wording and the Dedicated snippet to ThunderBay today. 2) ritesh_success - slide + audit sample ready by EOD tomorrow. 3) ana_legal - draft Hosted retention addendum language. 4) kai_security - prepare redacted audit snippet.

dana_se: Sending now. Message to customer: "Thanks for the questionnaire. Attaching SOC2 regions excerpt and a summary of our BYOK/retention support. For Hosted customers we offer provider-managed keys; BYOK is available on Dedicated/Private. If BYOK is mandatory for your renewal, we recommend a short scoping call to discuss Dedicated and timelines. Please confirm availability for a 30-minute call this week." :rocket: 

noah_cs: I've set the account health to 'at-risk' and bumped renewal probability as conditional on BYOK. I'll add CS-6022 to the renewal risk board.

kai_security: Internally: roadmap note - BYOK for Dedicated is in Q4 roadmap; Hosted BYOK is not planned this year. If they ask for Hosted parity, we should quantify engineering acceleration costs.

ana_legal: (ana_legal) will start draft addendum and post to CS-6022 as a draft.

noah_cs: Thanks. I'll paste the customer's reply into this thread once they respond.
